name: Artur Jorge
scopeNote: Artur Jorge Oliveira Soares, Portuguese coach born 1972 (NOT the Porto 1987 European Cup coach born 1946). Proposed counted spell, narrowed to the catalog team: Botafogo 2024 (Libertadores and Brasileirao). Start 2024-04-05 is the official announcement/presentation date (Soccerway PT; Braga confirmed the exit on 2024-04-03); end 2025-01-03 is the mutual rescission announced by Botafogo (Soccerway PT dated 2025-01-04 and search reports say 3 Jan); excluded spells carry partial dates (year or month) because they were not researched; day-level dates rest on press, not confirmed by a second dated page in the digest. Style names used by sources: 4-2-3-1 / 4-2-2-2 build, 4-2-4 (Correio Braziliense), vertical/direct attack with pairs and rotations, dropping 4-4-2 block (FotMob) vs 'marcacao alta' (Trivela, coach). No source found stating zonal or man-marking. Tactical coverage is mostly tier B blogs and tier C press; no Coaches' Voice or similar tier A study found (site: search returned none).
openQuestions: Pressing: coach and Trivela (May 2024) say high press; FotMob (Dec 2024) says they hardly press and drop into a 4-4-2 block. Possibly early-season vs full-season difference.
Defence: TFA (Aug 2024) calls the defensive record 'not highly desirable'; FotMob (Dec 2024) says fewest goals conceded; IstoE says 46 conceded in 52 games.
Zonal vs man-marking not documented in any mined source.
Exact start date: 2024-04-05 announcement vs first training/first match; confirm exit date (3 Jan 2025) with a second dated page.
Excluded spells (Braga, Olympiacos, Al Rayyan) are context only and their dates come from memory, not from mined pages; confirm if a broader profile is wanted.

sources.evidence: Botafogo are no strangers to taking their time in the initial stages of the build-up phase, passing the ball between themselves at a casual pace the back until the opposition decide to trigger the press – usually on the central player of the back three.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: Lining up in some variation of a 4-2-2-2 to 4-2-3-1 formation, they do not gradually progress through the thirds but instead like to look for their front four in transitional situations. That is why they play so many long balls.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: Jorge’s side do keep a healthy amount of possession as their average of 54.6% in the league this season places them sixth on that metric, but much of it is spent circulating the ball around the back looking for an opening.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: Dropping into a 4-4-2 block lower down the pitch, Botafogo have been able to restrict their opponents quite effectively through the sheer number of players they have behind the ball.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: They hardly look to press as a result, so their defensive line gradually drops back to prevent being breached in behind.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: Botafogo’s defending also feeds into their attacking approach as they tend to drop back out of possession, creating counterattacking opportunities after turnovers.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: Fogo are also the top crossers in the Brasileirão with an average of 5.8 accurate deliveries per 90, using them both in transition and to try and cause chaos against low blocks.

sources.title: Analysis: How Botafogo have put together their best-ever season (FotMob)
sources.evidence: there is a trend of increased directness emerging in many places. The Brazilian league, for its part, was never heavily influenced by the extremely control-oriented approaches that spread around Europe in recent times, so Botafogo’s direct attacking style is not much of a surprise in the local context.

statedView.quote: É característica da equipe pressionar muito alto, procurar recuperar bolas em zonas altas, estar posicionado em zonas mais altas para recuperar, condicionar ou obrigar o adversário a definir mal.
Começamos a defender em zonas altas e dentro do campo de ataque. É uma missão coletiva.
Nós teremos um Botafogo sempre igual, onde quer que fosse e contra quem quer que fosse.
Propor um jogo alegre, um jogo para ganhar, um jogo que tenha esse componente de espetáculo.
Tenho essas duas referências que me ajudaram a criar o meu próprio conceito de jogo e contextualizar
Não tenho dúvidas nenhumas de que fui o melhor treinador da história do Botafogo, por aquilo que conquistámos.
